integrationsPage.intro: Connect Entire VC Mesh with external services to automate workflows and keep your team in sync.

providers.github: Link pull requests and commits to tasks. Receive webhook events to auto-update task status.
providers.gitlab: Link merge requests to tasks on a self-hosted GitLab instance. Receive webhook events to auto-update task status.
providers.spark: Browse and install AI agents from the Spark catalog into your workspace.
providers.mcp: Connect AI agents (Claude Code, Cline, Aider) via Model Context Protocol. Supports stdio and SSE transports.
providers.telegram: Deliver notifications and activity to a Telegram bot. Each member connects their own account from Notification Settings.
providers.teamRelay: Sync project documents with a Team Relay share. The relay URL comes from this workspace or from the instance settings.

confirmDisable.message: This will turn off an integration configured at the instance level. It stops working for this workspace until it is enabled again.

github.webhookHelp: Add this URL to your GitHub repository under Settings → Webhooks. Select Pull requests and Pushes events. Include in commit messages or PR titles to auto-link tasks.

gitlab.connectPrompt: Connect your self-hosted GitLab instance: base URL, an access token for live MR-status checks, and a webhook secret.
gitlab.webhookHelp: Add this URL to your GitLab project under Settings → Webhooks. Select Merge request events. Include in commit messages or MR titles to auto-link tasks.
